title: vatica umbonata
intro: Vatica umbonata, commonly known as Borneo ironwood, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This tree has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Vatica umbonata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
